project, an owner whose notice is published: walked on the live arm only (a notice is signed with the instance's key, and the local install binds none (RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY): noticeprepare is refused NOTICE_NO_INSTANCE_KEY); there: a deployment holding its instance signing key, an owner who registered her own signing key on Account, a notice prepared, previewed and posted on the project

home, for the founder of a new team: walked on the live arm only (the founder of a new team is drawn only before a project or a second member exists, long before the carried states are walked); there: a development deployment freshly installed for the walk, opened as its founder before she invites anyone or starts a project
account, a newer version: the copy's /version answer was given by the walk's own route (no newer release is installed locally)

places, a state with no profile: a known gap (PD-10), drawn on neither arm: the United States (federal law) profile stays active whatever the team chooses on Places, so a team always holds a non-test profile and Places never draws its no-profile state

group-identity, an older installation, no short name recorded: a known gap (PD-10), drawn on neither arm: the installer records the team's short name at first boot, so no installation of this release lacks it

updates, the same, seen by the administrator who holds it: a known gap (PD-10), drawn on neither arm: needs a release notice newer than the running release and signed by Civicsmith's release keys, which no development deployment is given
unavailable, out of reach: the copy's whoami was answered 503 by the walk's own route

queue, an all-clear that cannot be given: a known gap (PD-10), drawn on neither arm: every feed of the copy answers, so an empty queue says nothing is waiting (the queue's other state, walked); a feed that fails cannot be made to by the screens

open-file, a file held after a finding: walked on the live arm only (a hold is placed only on a scanner's finding, and the local world's file scanner finds nothing); there: the EICAR test file uploaded into a question; the deployment's file scanner (ClamAV) finds it and holds the copy
